notes.notes:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/AmbitiousGenerousGoose-size_restricted.gif[/img]

[h1]Update 22: Wizard's Deal[/h1]

[b]Hey there, Orc Hunters![/b]
In today's patch we're bringing in some flashy new toys, we discover a forgotten, challenging region of the world and drop a ton of fixes and quality improvements! 

Fight through the dusty storms of Torket region with trusty dual axes by your side, or just fireball everything using The Scorching Wand.

See you in the Broken Lands!



[h1]Patch Notes - Long Read![/h1]
[b]New:[/b][list]
[*]Added a new ranged weapon: "Scorching Wand". Let's all be fire mages now!
[*]Added a new melee weapon: "The Cyclone" dual axes, sporting awesome wolf heads.
[*]Added a new region: Torket. This dried landscape is home to everlasting sandstorms. Beware of enemies hiding in the storm!
[*]Added Quest plot Voice overs to loading screens. Cheers to UpstartCrowe for amazing work!
[*]Added over 40 new orc lines by our great UpstartCrowe.
[*]When playing in single player, Players will now have up to 3 Revives per level.
[*]Grass and Snow regions will now sometimes be played in a delightful sunset conditions.
[*]Added a Mute option to Party List and an Icon to show who's speaking.
Vive users can now rotate their Play area by swiping left or right on the touchpad. Thanks to mykhrochyp for the tip!
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b][list]
[*]Major performance improvements across all platforms - you should see over 25% more frames!
[*]Healing a downed player in co-op games will now take 2 seconds, down from 4 seconds before.
[*]Crossbows will no longer shoot when you're clicking something in the menu.
[*]Game will now handle disconnects better - Player will no longer get stuck in the sky.
[*]Smooth play area rotation is now available on every motion method besides teleport.
[*]Walk direction based on controller is now available on Joystick Walk locomotion as well.
[*]XP Books will now be picked up automatically when Player walks over it.
[*]Quest briefing and its voiceover no longer will be displayed when Player returns from a mission.
[*]Players can now freely walk through enemies as ghosts.
[*]Locked items will now be visible in a grayed-out form to give players an impression of what the're missing!
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b][list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Player would bounce off some terrain features when using walk locomotion.
[*]Fixed an issue where enemies would sometimes ignore that they're being shot from afar.
[*]Fixed a bug which stopped enemies from saying taunt voice lines in multiplayer games.
[*]Fixed a bug which caused throwing knives to earn 70% less xp per use compared to other gadgets.
[*]Fixed a bug where Guardian would notify player about nearby chest when other player gets close to one.
[*]Fixed a bug where XP books would only add 1 xp to sheathed weapons. [*]Thanks to Lokimut for reporting this!
[*]Fixed numerous depth conflicts between Player View UI and world objects.
[*]Fixed weird lines visible when animating into and out of Vignette.
[*]Fixed Orc statue on Home Island sitting on its ass.
[*]Fixed an issue where controller tooltips would jump around when walking or teleporting.
[*]Walking through the ending portal when dead will no longer trigger the end of the level.
[*]Fixed a bug where opening Upgrade menu via prompt on the pillar would not show the currently equipped item.
[*]Teleport icon no longer obstructs Player's view for a split second when blink teleporting.
[*]Fixed an issue where a stutter would occur after entering exit portal on host.
[*]Fixed weird bolt trail graphic glitch during rapid shooting with a crossbow.
[*]Fixed a bug where upgrade screen would not be properly placed, not open or show wrong item.
[*]Fixed issues in matchmaking database that would cause too much data to be generated.
[*]Fixed a bug where joining a multiplayer while in the starter menu would make Player unable to move. Thanks to Alicia from Augmentality Labs for reporting this!
[/list]


[h1]Shameless advertising[/h1]
Lets grow the Trickster family!

notes.notes:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/QuickLongChinesecrocodilelizard-size_restricted.gif[/img]


[h1]Update 21: Spoils of War[/h1]

[b]Howdy Orc Hunters![/b]
In today's patch we're introducing a couple of new drops, a new Powerup and a trove of fixes and improvements! Worth mentioning - that pesky bug that made scrolls duplicate and get stuck is no more!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
New:[list]
[*]Added new Powerup - Scroll Of Shield. It deploys a handy shield that's impenetrable to all enemy projectiles.
[*]Added new dropped item - Orb of Power - that recharges power meter on weapons when picked up.
[*]Added new dropped item - Tome of Knowledge. When picked up, it rewards you with XP points for all weapons you currently carry.
[/list]
Improvements:[list]
[*]Game Room and Game Region transitions will now fade to black instead of freezing the game for a few seconds.
[*]Added a separate SFX Volume setting to menu.
[*]Upgraded dropped ammo model for better visibility on the ground.
[*]Added a timeout to stop game stuck on PEER CREATED errors.
[*]Player's footsteps will now sound differently on grass and on stone, for some added immersion.
[*]Increased max allowed ping to join a region to 250.
[/list]
Bugfixes:[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Push To Talk tooltip on oculus touch was assigned to a wrong button.
[*]Fixed a small graphic glitch with push to talk icon.
[*]Fixed a bug where picking up many powerups at once would sometimes make Player drop them when trying to use one. (Thanks to Rich G for help with this one.)
[*]Fixed a bug where grabbing a powerup from a belt when standing over another powerup would not equip any. 
[*]Fixed a bug where red shaman familiars would sometimes break the game and cause the Home Island to vanish post-level. (Thanks again Rich!)
[*]Fixed a bug in PSVR alpha build where the screen would not turn black&white after Player has died.
[*]Fixed an issue where post-game scoreboard would contain different values for some players in the same game.
[*]Hitting the dummies on Home Island will no longer charge your weapon during Wave Attack game mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 20: The Mastery
notes.notes:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/ThirstyFrigidCygnet-size_restricted.gif[/img]

Hey there orc hunters!
We have a trove of new stuff for you today. With brand new Weapon Mastery system, each time you use an item, it will gain some XP points towards new power level. With each new level, you'll unlock meaningful upgrades, like better damage, longer reach or bigger power range. 

To pay for all these new upgrades, you're going to need an orcish ton of gold! Luckily, gold is relatively easy to come by in Broken Lands, as orc purses and hidden chests will keep you in good supply.

Plus, the good ol' Wooden Shield gained a new awesome power. Shield-throw those pesky orcs into oblivion!


[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]New:[/b][list]
[*]The starter gear - Sword & Shield - has received a new Power - Disk Throw. Live that Captain America fantasy!
[*]Weapon Mastery system - using weapons now grant players Mastery Levels for them. 
[*]Weapon Upgrade system - Mastery Levels unlock special upgrades that make items vastly more powerful.
[*]Gold drops - monsters and chests now drop gold used to upgrade items.
[*]Added item tab to the Menu - one convenient place to upgrade your items and check their stats.
[*]Every item now has a detailed description with its properties. These can be viewed in the menu.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b][list]
[*]Rewritten Matchmaking code to use 80% less data and solve constant loading bug some players were experiencing.
[*]Controller code, Shaders, Save System, Main Menu and Motion system have all been rewritten in preparations for Playstation VR version.
[*]Settings Tab has be redone for better readability.
[*]Items will now play a distinct sound when their powers are recharged.
[*]Added sound feedback to menu.
[*]Controllers will now show a ghostly overlay when a tooltip is displayed, but the model is hidden.
[*]Weapon powers can now be charged by hitting Hay Dummies on Home Island and on Adventure Levels.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b][list]
[*]Controllers will now be properly hidden when using crossbows.
[*]Burn Books quest will now appear more often. 
[*]Fixed a bug where grabbing and immediately releasing a gadget on the belt would break it for a few seconds.
[*]Fixed a bug where teleporting into the portal with blink teleport locomotion would not count as jumping into the portal.
[*]Fixed a bug where throwing healing flask near the portal would sometimes make it misfire.
[*]Fixed a bug where wave attack games would sometimes not start.
[*]Fixed a bug where hitting a dead enemy would charge melee weapon power.
[/list]


[h1]Hotfix 1 - October 29th[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Push To Talk Voice Chat mode would sometimes become unresponsive.
[*]Fixed an issue which made unlocked weapon rewards unresponsive in coop mode.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused a lot of game system break after launching a second game in coop mode.
[*]Fixed a few too large colliders in game levels and another bunch with improper hardness settings.[/list]

[h1]Shameless self-advertising[/h1]
Lets grow the Trickster family!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25923504/cd47804e001fb8f6aef92964dd88d3b895214249.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update 19: Burned Books
notes.notes:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/AdoredDisloyalHagfish-size_restricted.gif[/img]

Hey there orc hunters!
In this week's patch we bring you a new challenge to take, some new epic spells and a powerful adversary to test your skills against. Updated post-game stats better show each hero's contribution to the party's success. We've made some powerups much easier to use and fixed some nasty bugs!

See you in the Broken Lands!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
New[list]
[*]Added new Post-Game stats. Player's score now also depends on healing done, damaged parried and longest shot that hit the mark.
[*]Added new Powerup - Scroll of Meteor. Use this mass destruction device to obliterate everything that stands in your path.
[*]Added new Quest - A Burning Matter
[*]Added new Enemy - Pyromancer
[*]Added Walk Speed adjustment to Settings. Thank you to [b]Dwight Frightening[/b] for this suggestion!
[/list]
Improvments:[list]
[*]Powerups can only be grabbed from belt when player is looking at them. This is to prevent accidental grabs.
[*]Crossfire crossbows will now automatically refil magazines when their power is activated.
[*]Scroll of Cone of Healing is now Scroll of Healing Blast. Instantly heals players within range when cast.
[*]Scroll of Healing and Healing Flask will now show healing VFX on targets.
Scroll of Ressurect now automatically targets dead players in the direction it was cast. No need to aim the projectile.
[*]Scroll of Conjured Spear now has a little autoaim to help with targeting.
[/list]
Bugfixes:[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where attacking with shield and some off hand weapons would sometimes not work while moving.
Drops will now properly disappear after some time.
[*]Fixed dead enemies showing empty health bars after dying on clients
[*]Fixed Red Crystal stutter when moving.
[*]Fixed Green Shaman spawns in Trimming the weeds quest so they won't get stuck in geometry.
[*]Fixed a bug where remote player damage effects could be heard across an entire map.
[*]Scroll of Force projectile now regains its missing sound.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 18: A Warm Welcome
notes.notes:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/AnchoredSkinnyAngelfish-size_restricted.gif[/img]

Here are some highlights from today's patch. For full patch notes, head below!

1. Melee weapons now have better collision with world and enemies.
2. Ranged weapons require ammo. Make your shots count!
3. Players and Enemies can now show Health bars.
5. We've added Powerups to make gameplay more varied and make some higher level spells accessible for beginner players. 
5. We've added first part of the drop system. Ammo and Powerups can now drop from enemies and magic chests around the world.


Here's are the single use Powerups you can find during your adventures:
Scroll of Dragon Breath
Scroll of Fireball
Scroll of Force
Scroll of Conjured Spear
Scroll of Healing Spray
Scroll of Resurrection



[h1] Full Patch Notes [/h1]
[b]New:[/b][list]
[*]Melee weapons now also collide with scenery and enemies when not being swung.
[*]Ranged weapons now require ammo. Ammo can be found throughout the world and in drops from enemies.
[*]Health bar options added to the game. You can choose between Health bars for players, bosses, all Enemies or none at all. (muh immershun!)
[*]Added Power Ups to the game - single use magical scrolls, potions and bombs that drop from chests and enemies.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b][list]
[*]Desktop view now uses wider angle camera for better viewing experience.
[*]Updated to newest Unity, SteamVR and third party plugins version for increased performance.
[*]Parry sound effects are now more pronounced.
[*]Weapon hit haptics are now stronger.
[*]Gadgets and Powerups will now be properly visible in remote player's hand when picked up.
[*]Guardian will now let you know when another hero dies and needs your help.
[*]Players can now damage enemies with melee while moving or teleporting.
[*]The Guardian will now periodically drop ammo and powerups during Wave Attack game mode.
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b][list]
[*]Changed how the Game Settings are saved. This may mean you'll have to change your settings again.
[*]Dual Crossbows now reload 25% faster, shoot 25% faster, are 25% more accurate and deal 25% less damage with each shot.
[*]Scroll of Fireball and Scroll of Force are now called Books. Their models have been updated. Functionality stays the same.
[*]Lantern is now placed on the left side of Player's belt and no longer can be carried. This is to make room on belt for new PowerUps
[*]Playspace Center marker is now on by default.
[*]Green Shamans now must wait for 10 seconds to start casting heal after being spawned. This will make Keeper fights a little easier.
[*]Game will now let players know when their play space is not set up properly.
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes:[/b][list]
[*]Fixed a bug which caused basic enemies to remain silent during the fight.
[*]Fixed overboosted sounds in Skyships, Islands and Quests.
[*]Fixed an issue where last level in the game would not give it's reward ("The Kindness" dual knives)
[*]Fixed an issue where setting lobby to private would in some cases not hide it from game list completely.
[*]Fixed an issue where Party list would sometimes not show players in the group.
[/list]


[h1]Hotfix 1 - August 26th [/h1]
[list][*]Fixed issue which caused voice chat to stop working.
[*]Fixed ammo counter being occluded by controller on Oculus Home.
[*]Fixed issue that would mess up text in multiplayer menu.
[/list]


[h1]Shameless advertising[/h1]
Lets grow the Trickster family.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/recommended/recommendgame/512220]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25923504/cd47804e001fb8f6aef92964dd88d3b895214249.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update 16: The Wolf
notes.notes:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/QuickLongChinesecrocodilelizard-size_restricted.gif[/img]

This week's update bring back the mighty Howler Bow and Scroll of Force. The pushback power of both of these items is enough to make your enemies vanish over the horizon. If you previously unlocked these items you can now instantly proceed to play our new favorite game  -  "Who can throw an Orc over that bridge?"

There is also a few important bugfixes coming in this update. Most notably - you'll no longer switch back to starter weapons when joining a coop game.

[b]New: [/b][list]
[*]Added Scroll of Force.
[*]Added The Howler Bow.
[*]Female Avatar is back. You can switch to it in the settings.
[*]Added enemy head shot hit icons for more clarity in combat. These can be turned off in the menu.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b][list]
[*]Crossfire crossbows now take 1.2 seconds to reload, up from, well, 0
[*]Crossfire shot cooldown increased to 0.25 seconds, up from 0.2 seconds

[*]Increased the number of spawned enemies on casual difficulty on big islands to make fights more common.
[/list]

[*]Fixed a bug where dead enemy would grunt on hit on clients.

[*]Fixed a bug where when upon rejoining the same game twice, player would see his last equipment hovering in the air.

[*]Fixed Power meter working erratically on Defender's Insignia, The Kindness and Whirlwind.
[*]Defender's Insignia will no longer charge its power after 1 hit. 
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix and the State of the Co-op
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25923504/e65b1d04825672d6fa38f9107003fac6965addcb.jpg[/img]

A new hotfix to last week's patch with some important bugfixes and requested features you asked for. Also, a little insight on where we are with the co-op mode.


[h1] A brand new hotfix! [/h1]
Changes and Improvements[list]
[*]Blink teleport is now default for Teleport Locomotion.
[*]Added an option to change dialog volume to options.
[*]Entering the portal without melee or ranged weapon will make player equip the default one.
[*]Ballistas now use teleport assist to easier move player into right position.
[*]Skyships now explode when shot down, killing the crew on the spot.
[/list]

Bugfixes[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where enemies dropped from a killed skyship would be invincible. 
[*]Fixed a bug where switching to two handed weapons would make them appear with wrong rotation.
[*]Fixed a bug where pooled arrows would continue their trail from last position.
[*]Fixed a few places where orc projectiles would get stuck on invisible objects.
[*]Fixed arrows getting stuck in enemy spawners on mission end.
[*]Fixed a bug where skyships would sometimes drop troops on level entry portal.
[*]Skyships will no longer bleed and scream in pain when damaged.
[*]Skyships will no longer drop troops through Cathedral's roof.
[*]Fixed a bug where Find the flock objective in  Murder the flock quest could not be completed.
[/list]


[h1]State of the Co-op[/h1]
As some of you already know, we have a great ambition to bring online coop to the game. The work has already started and I'm happy to say that with client-sided hit detection the game maintains its fast paced and responsive feel. This of course only works now in a test enviroment, as all of the game components are slowly being upgraded to broadcast relevant data over the network. 

First test version will be available at the[b]beggining of May[/b] on experimental branch. The goal of this version will be to test the netcode and how well unity relay servers can support a bandwidth-heavy VR game.

What will the experimental version include?
[list]
[*]4 player wave attack game mode.
[*]Basic enemies.
[*]Starter weapons.
[*]Simple UI-based lobby system. (boring, but fast and easy!)
[*]Placeholder player models (think RecRoom dismembered ghosts)
[/list]

PS. Adventure mode should also happen around that time, although the quests will come later.

notes.title: Update 14 - A Friend in Need
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25923504/f2cdfe2e0ebf19cd3b7155f27111b066c650fc8b.png[/img]

[b]Update 14 - A Friend in Need[/b]
A big update, just in time for the weekend. Drop into the Broken Lands to say hello to your new companion. His out-of-this-world voice will smoothly guide you through your adventures, with just a tiniest bit of mockery. And yes, we do have some new tools of the trade to try out!


[b]Scroll of Force[/b]
Ever wanted to fling orcs to their deaths with a flick of a finger? You'll love this one. This short range spell is a great tool to make some breathing room when you're surrounded. Plus, there is something weirdly satisfying about using it. You can find it in Nordhall.

[b]The Kindness[/b]
Double treat for knife lovers. Its very short range and almost no defensive capabilities makes it as dangerous for the wielder as for the victim. It makes up for it with high armor piercing damage - don't have to look for open spots on heavy armored enemies any more. Its "Fan of Knives" special ability makes it easy to clear enemies right in front of you. As a bonus, holding the trigger on your controller makes the character switch to "blade down" grip. Find it in The Hollows.

Full patch notes below!


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25923504/30ab2134db011c8739f7ab67d97d83c801c5ef08.jpg[/img]

[b]New features and improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new outwordly companion to guide you through the world of Trickster! UpstartCrowe did a great job recording tracks for the character.
[*]Added a new weapon - The Kindness - dual knives to play out your favorite rogue fantasy.
[*]Added a new gadget - Scroll of Force - Send your enemies flying, just like you always wanted to.
[*]Orcs gained 13 new voice lines. Additional credit for UpstartCrowe!
[*]Reduced Red Crystal ray rotation speed by 70% on casual and 30% on brave difficulty. Will make it easier to beat.
[*]Added a helper for teleport locomotion users to move next to the campaign map easier.
[*]Rift users can now use grip trigger to pick up weapons and select levels
[*]Players can now change in which hand they want to hold the bow regardless of their dominant hand.
[*]A new sound effect for heavy damaged player.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where Smooth Controller turning would not be remembered after the game closes.
[*]Fixed a bug where changing dominant hand with crossbow equipped would break it.
[*]Fixed a bug where hit percentage and kill streaks would not be counted for some weapons.
[*]Fixed crossbow bolts not getting stuck into the terrain.
[*]Fixed a weird invisible terrain glitch at the top of the stairs in broken tower tile.
[*]Fixed treasure chest shooting blood particles in the air.
[*]Fixed a bug where killing crows on casual difficulty would sometimes complete the quest multiple times.
[/list]


[h1]Hotfix 1 - March 24th:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added new voice lines to wave attack mode - portal will now politely let you know when you're slacking.
[*]Added new voice tips to each quest.
[*]Added new misc portal voices.
[/list]

[h1]TL;DR: If you're on Oculus Touch, you'll get better experience on experimental branch. More info below.[/h1]

[*]Proper button layout - no more missing controls.

[*]To move push right joystick forward or backwards.

[*]A / X to switch between melee and ranged.
[*]Trigger to interact with stuff. (Duh)

This week's update concentrates on many bugs and issues you've reported. Thanks a lot for leaving the feedback that helps make the game better. To make things a little more interesting than "boring" bugfixes, we're also adding a [b]brand new ragdoll system[/b]. 

Have fun teaching orcs to fly!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25923504/87a3f2eee89de89a4ae09e2e3a036a8868c6dac9.gif[/img]

[h1]Community Vote[/h1]
Getting into the voting craze, last week we asked you which feature you'd like to see in Trickster first. Here are the results:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25923504/6091bf2b96dbdeddfbbda5990659993a9c0d7eab.png[/img]

What does it mean for the game? For the next month dev efforts will concentrate on bringing new weapons and ways to acquire them. The mission map will also be expanded with regions you'll have to unlock. The harder the region, the better the rewards will be. 



[h1]Oculus Touch support[/h1]
Some time before the end of the year Trickster will also get Oculus Touch support. For a game that's planning on adding multiplayer along the way, having a bigger player pool is very beneficent. 



[h1]Update 7 notes [/h1]
[b]New Features[/b]
Added Ragdoll to the game. Send orcs flying with your mighty punch! Sword, shield and arrow shots all now realistically affect orc bodies.

[b]Changes, Improvements and bugfixes:[/b]

Animations:
Fixed a bug where enemies would would shake when taking last step towards the player.
Fixed enemies "wiggling" while walking up the slopes.
Shield orc will now have access to all the animation sets other orcs use.
Added 3 new parry animations and 3 new attack animations.

AI:
Fixed a bug where enemies would rotate left/right before an attack.
Enemies are now less likely to walk inside each other.
Orc Hunters will now properly walk around other orcs when their line of sight is blocked.
Fixed a bug where enemies would stand in place and rotate constantly.
Enemies will now actively move away from the player when he attempts to "walk inside" them.
Fixed a bug where dead enemies would rotate to face the player.


Procedural Levels:
Improved Procedural generation algorythm to create more branches.
Fixed bug where tiles where sometimes placed on top of other tiles, creating an impassable passage.
Stopped Adventure Mode floating rocks from spawning inside islands.
Added bigger clouds to procedural levels.


Other:
Added tooltip to teach new players how to move in walk mode.
Enemy Arrow will now get stuck in a shield with a proper meaty sound.
Changes Music setting to volume instead of on/off
Added haptic feedback to shield.

[h1]Look for some cover![/h1]
This week in the world of Trickster, the Orcs have done their homework. They've recruited Orc Hunters to join their ranks and rain down support fire to cover their advance. A good few of them also learned additional ranged attacks, some can now summon familiars and some can place down area-denial traps to make your job even harder.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25923504/81a155154e176519af8fdda784f69b14b03f157d.gif[/img] 


[h1]The Dropship[/h1]
There is also that new ragtag dropship Orcs will use to try to ambush you. In a world shattered to little bits and pieces, ingenuity starts to shine. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25923504/8fb1858ba4537e456c2f364a190f864e981ffb70.gif[/img]



With all these changes, you may find the Broken Lands much harder to travel through. So let's even the playing field a little.



[h1]A new weapon - The Piercer[/h1]
This ancient arcane bow can channel the primal energies into a single, armor piercing bolt. Position is key here, but well placed shot can easily take out an entire group of enemies.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25923504/284de6e3bc84489ea7d2ee7274238d7c72082bca.jpg[/img]


[h1]Walk Locomotion[/h1]
An important feature you asked for - Walk Locomotion -  can now selected in the settings menu. Hold the touchpad to move forward at a steady pace and aim the controller up or down to adjust the speed. And, so you're not left without a tactical advantage, use double tap on the touchpad to teleport away from danger.

notes.title: Update 3 - A Sudden Call to Arms
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25923504/d44e3767e9f44fc7e45f462ece7692c076e1891a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Look for some cover![/h1]
This week in the world of Trickster, the Orcs have done their homework. They've recruited Orc Hunters to join their ranks and rain down support fire to cover their advance. A good few of them also learned additional ranged attacks, some can now summon familiars and some can place down area-denial traps to make your job even harder.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25923504/81a155154e176519af8fdda784f69b14b03f157d.gif[/img] 


[h1]The Dropship[/h1]
There is also that new ragtag dropship Orcs will use to try to ambush you. In a world shattered to little bits and pieces, ingenuity starts to shine. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25923504/8fb1858ba4537e456c2f364a190f864e981ffb70.gif[/img]



With all these changes, you may find the Broken Lands much harder to travel through. So let's even the playing field a little.



[h1]A new weapon - The Piercer[/h1]
This ancient arcane bow can channel the primal energies into a single, armor piercing bolt. Position is key here, but well placed shot can easily take out an entire group of enemies.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25923504/284de6e3bc84489ea7d2ee7274238d7c72082bca.jpg[/img]


[h1]Walk Locomotion[/h1]
An important feature you asked for - Walk Locomotion -  can now selected in the settings menu. Hold the touchpad to move forward at a steady pace and aim the controller up or down to adjust the speed. And, so you're not left without a tactical advantage, use double tap on the touchpad to teleport away from danger.



[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]0.2.5[/b]
New Features:
Added "walk" locomotion method available in the settings. Press the touchpad to move in constant pace.
New enemy - Orc Hunter. Look for cover, this one is a real sharpshooter.
Added two new tiles (that's a 25% increase!) to procedural level system.

Changes, Improvements and bugfixes:
Added one more variation of common orc warrior.
Some orcs will now throw axes at the player.
Red Shamans learned how to summon a familiar that gives them even more firepower!
Blue Shamans can now summon an arcane orb, perfect for area denial attacks.
Fixed teleport effect being displayed when vignette was off.
Fixed a bug where teleport effects would show with walk locomotion.
Fixed a bug where player could move with walk locomotion during game loading time.

[b]0.2.6[/b]
New Features:
Added new Piercer Bow. Take it for a spin!
Added Orc dropship that will sometimes try to ambush player.
Added Damage Prompt that pops up when you get hit from behind.

Changes, Improvements and bugfixes:
Added footsteps to walk locomotion.
Walk locomotion speed can now be slowed down by aiming the controlelr down.
Added teleport on double tap to walk locomotion.
Fixed teleport marker being displayed for brieg second on walk locomotion.
Made end level portal rune activate when player touches the rune or the sign above it.

notes.title: Update 2 - The Broken Lands
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25923504/41d20a99740411900daf044fe49a1b460f453663.jpg[/img]

Procedurally generated levels, two enemies, three biomes, first four quests and entirely new game mode - that's what waiting for you in newest addition to the Trickster!

Head below for a detailed [b]changelog[/b].


[b]0.2.4[/b]
New Features:
[list]
[*]Added quest markers visible in the sky in Adventure Mode.
[*]New Quest Added - "A Murder of Crows"
[/list]
Changes, Improvements and bugfixes:
[list]
[*]Added snow particles to frozen islands.
[*]Improved mission select table to be easier to use.
[*]Red Crystal health and damage now depends on difficulty setting.
[*]Teleport will now have a longer cooldowm (0.5 seconds, up from 0.2 seconds.)
[*]Fixed vignette setting displaying wrong value in settings menu.
[*]Fixed players being able to teleport onto enemy islands in wave attack mode.
[*]Improved Adventure Mode end portal rune visibility.
[/list]


[b]0.2.3[/b]
New features:
[list]
[*]Added basic Biome system. Now Adventure Levels can take place in grassland, frozen and desert islands.
[/list]
Changes, Improvements and bugfixes:
[list]
[*]Added an option to turn off teleport vignette in the settings.
[/list]


[b]0.2.2[/b]
New features:
[list]
[*]Added two new Quests to Adventure Mode: "Chain of Command" and "Into the Source"
[*]Added two new quest-related enemies - The Warchief and The Red Crystal.
[/list]
Changes, Improvements and bugfixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a metric ton of pathing issues in Adventure Mode levels. 
[*]Enemies will now attack the player when hit from behind their aggro range.
[*]Enemies will now signal nearby allies to help them fighting the player.
[*]Adventure Mode map will now show the main quest details upon selecting the mission.
[*]Fixed a bug where exit portal on a level would end up inaccesible for enemies.
[*]Wave Attack mode now has a countdown before launching.
[/list]


[b]0.2.1[/b]
New Features:
[list]
[*]Added new music system, 4 new battle tracks and 1 new calm track.
[*]Added basic portal defence quest to procedural levels. Finishing a level won't be such a breeze any more.
[/list]
Changes, Improvements and bugfixes:
[list]
[*]Added birds on Adventure levels.
[*]Added a tooltip for all the quests in the level displayed when player first enters it.
[*]Portal defence on Adventure Levels will now take 45 seconds before a player can return home.
[*]Added Title and plot of main quest for each level to loading screen.
[*]Modified Adventure Mode levels logic - Levels will now be created based on given main and side quests.
[*]Fixed too many enemies being spawned on Adventure levels causing the game to lag.
[*]Fixed broken pathing in numerous tiles
[*]Fixed enemies turning around when player is unreachable. 
[*]Fixed arrows getting stuck in map pedestal growing to huge sizes.
[*]Fixed collisions for a bunch of stone objects - arrows won't get stuck in them any more.
[*]Enemies will now wander around when no target is around.
[*]Fixed some enemies swinging their weapons when out of reach to the player.
[*]Improved Player teleport to avoid getting stuck in the walls on procedural levels.
[*]Added better vfx to rune activation.
[*]Fixed a bug where Difficulty Picker on portal island was visible during a wave attack game.
[/list]


[b]0.2.0[/b]
New Features:
[list]
[*]Added new very big feature - Adventure Mode - this will be the core of the Trickster gameplay from now on.
[*]Modified starter Island to be better suited for mission selection in Adventure Mode. Wave Attack is now a secondary game mode.
[/list]
Changes, Improvements and bugfixes:
[list]
[*]Difficulty and game type will now be picked from the map in the middle of the starter island.
[*]Changed lighting and some texture colors to add some vibrance to color palette.
[*]Player menu now can be opened with both controller's app buttons.
[*]Player menu will now be more compact and use steam-like control method.
[*]Player menu now contains quest tracker used in Adventure mode.
[*]Removed rocks around the portal.
[*]Added 3 new attack animations for orcs.
[*]Added 2 new hurt animations for orcs.
[*]Added new equip sounds.
[*]Teleporter has been changed to allow for easier movement up and down slope
[*]Improved some existing sounds.
[*]Added grass with proper wind behaviour to the game.
[*]Improved colors and contrast of some textures for more consistent pallete.
[*]Slightly tweaked bloom and color correction settings.
[*]Removed some unused textures that have been eating up memory.
[/list]

[img]http://i.giphy.com/9WqlXpiXkaFMI.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update 1
notes.notes:
Trickster 0.1.4 is now live. It contains a new weapon and a few improvements based on the feedback from the community. Here's what you can expect:

[h1]0.1.4 - Update 1[/h1]
[b]New features and improvements:[/b]
Added new weapon.Throwing darts! Release your inner ninja. You can find it on one of the pillars.
Added bow draw length setting to the app menu.
Arrow hit sounds changed for ones packing more punch.
Improved bow mechanics: you can press the trigger before nocking the arrow to pull the bow. 
Added weapon stats to app menu.
Sword will now return to belt if its released near it.
Moved the sword mount point a little closer to the player.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
Statue sword will have collision now.
Fixed no shadows bug some users where experiencing.
Fixed a bug where Rogue Orc would throw smoke when dead. (again!)
Fixed a bug where islands would start launching debris while on game stats screen.

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
Bow Draw Length is not saved between game sessions yet.



[h1]Let us know how you like the throwing darts and new bow sounds![/h1]
